changelog: Amplicon PDF report: Bray-Curtis values that round to 1.00 print three decimals in the text too; read-tracking caption says 'classified' when no chimera filter ran; the Emu species table separates named species from unnamed reference strains ('sp. ...'); the beta section notes taxa that dominate one sample but appear at trace level (≤0.5%) in another, which may be barcode / index cross-talk. Beta: ONT 16S settings table lists only the parameters Emu uses. No restart needed.

previous.changelog: ONT 16S (Emu): reference-based chimera removal (VSEARCH --uchime_ref) is now OFF by default. On TH-BIOENTIST-00004 it removed 30% of PGU-16S_full, almost all of it one genus (Paenimyroides 37.6k → 10.7k reads, -72%) while every other genus moved 2-10% — genuine reads of a taxon the reference covers poorly were scored as chimeras. Emu's own method applies no chimera filter. It can still be switched on per run (beta: 'Chimera removal (VSEARCH)'; CLI: --chimera). The PDF report states which applied. emu_pipeline.py and report_builder.py need no restart; the new checkbox reaches the pipeline after a backend restart.
